title: データサイエンス基礎Ⅱ
subtitle: Data Science for Beginners 2
courseType: Mathematics and Science ProgramMathematics and Science Courses
educationalGoal:
Utilization of data is indispensable for realizing the smart society Society 5.0, and it will be indispensable in the future to acquire a background in data science.
In this lecture, we will discuss,　
1) Cluster analysis　2) Decision tree analysis　
3) (artificial) neural networks
The goal is to acquire the three methods through lectures and exercises.
advice:
In this class, we will learn "classification (discrimination)" and "prediction", which are important uses of data science, through lectures and exercises.
First, we will understand what machine learning is, and learn the theory and usage of three typical methods: cluster analysis, decision tree analysis, and (artificial) neural network.
"Cluster analysis" groups similar things together
It is a method that is representative of unsupervised machine learning. ``Decision tree'' is a technique for automatically creating a tree structure for classification, and is a powerful technique for machine learning with supervised data. An “(artificial) neural network” simulates the brain nervous system.
It is a powerful method of machine learning with supervised data.
Each time, in addition to lectures based on classroom lectures, we will conduct exercises in which we actually move our hands and perform analysis. The mathematical explanation of the mathematical background of each method is kept to a minimum to facilitate understanding of the method. Make sure you take the time to explain. Any unclear points should be resolved during class, and time should be allocated for review.
books:
Do not use textbooks.
References will be given as appropriate in class.
requiredKnowledge: It is compulsory to take the preceding course, "Fundamentals of Data Science I". Furthermore, it is strongly recommended that students also take ``Statistics for Engineers'' to learn the basics of statistics. Please bring your own laptop PC because analysis tools will be used in every class.
